_note: Event Mode countdown hud, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. edge_color is the text outline; text_nudge moves the text inside its glyph box.

stopwatch._note: the stopwatch's face centred at x, y; the seconds in its box, box_dy below, at most text_width wide (the glyph box, 25 px padding each side included)

countdown._note: the seconds turn red (and tick each second) from red_from_s down

plays._note: the plays left in a cream pill, its top-left at x, y beside the stopwatch, or at solo_x, solo_y without a countdown
